purpose: Re-render the provisional Appendix300 appearance candidate on the current FEM-bound appendix display surface with render-only subdivision enabled.

render.camera: Newton endoscope, 1280x720, 2 samples per pixel, 0 bounces
render.mapping: Full-resolution Appendix300 RGB sampled at ray-hit UVs from cylindrical coordinates on appendix FEM rest nodes; UV binding follows FEM deformation
render.render_surface: Captured appendix PLY bound to FEM nodes, one Loop subdivision level for display only
render.interpretation: The change is localized to the displayed appendix region and verifies that the video-derived RGB reaches the subdivided Newton endoscope render. Independent path-tracer renders are not a same-random-seed pixel-exact ablation; the difference statistics are descriptive, not a calibrated quality score.

limitations: The texture is a provisional SAM2 prompt-mask candidate; the visible source object has not been expert-confirmed as appendix tissue.
Cylindrical projection is an appearance mapping, not a reconstruction of camera-to-mesh correspondence or patient-specific 3-D anatomy.
Observed RGB retains some illumination and specular appearance; intrinsic albedo and BRDF are not measured.
The wide endoscope composition, anatomy, tissue material, and contact deformation still fail the realism gate; no blinded expert review or held-out video evaluation has been completed.
The source texture and rendered images remain local in the git-ignored output tree; this tracked report contains provenance hashes and aggregate image statistics only.
